scope: Register, protocol and allocation references for a733_pcie_function.c and a733_pcie_nvme.c. Linux and U-Boot do not run on the A733 FreeRTOS root; the adapted logic is rewritten for polled native ownership.

bsp/drivers/pci/controller/allwinner/pci.use: SII INTx mask/status and DesignWare MSI target, enable and status handling
INTx demultiplexing on the sii interrupt and LTSSM disable before teardown

sun60iw2p1.dtsi.use: INTIDs 184 (sii) and 185 (msi), the 0x22000000 32-bit memory range and the INTA..INTD map

drivers/pci/pci_auto.c.use: BAR sizing with decode off and 64-bit BARs placed below 4 GiB

drivers/nvme/nvme.c.use: Two-entry admin and I/O queues, phase-tagged polled completion, identify, queue creation and read commands

drivers/nvme/nvme.h.use: Controller register layout, CAP fields, CC and CSTS bits and opcodes
